title: Replace all service images with professional photos and fix search functionality

requirements.text: Replace ALL service card images across all 48+ services with real professional photos showing actual technicians performing services. Specifically replace: AC Installation (blank/missing image), AC Gas Refill, Tap Repair (broken image), Furniture Repair (cartoon workshop illustration), Door & Window Fixing (cartoon diagram with multiple panels), and all other services with cartoon illustrations, blank images, or broken placeholders. Use realistic, high-quality photos with proper cropping (object-fit: cover), rounded corners matching card design. Do NOT use cartoons, illustrations, icons, or placeholders.

quotes: All sub categories images replace add new
Don't use any cartoon or animated images please. Add real one like service photos

acceptanceCriteria: All 48+ individual service cards display real professional photos of technicians performing that specific service
No cartoon illustrations (like Furniture Repair workshop scene or Door & Window Fixing diagram panels) remain
No blank images, broken image placeholders, or grey placeholders remain
All images use object-fit: cover with consistent dimensions and rounded corners
Each service has a unique, realistic, service-relevant photo

requirements.text: Fix search bar functionality in the navigation menu to filter services in real-time as the user types. Display filtered results in a dropdown below the search input showing matching service names, categories, and descriptions. Clicking a search result should navigate to that specific service on the Services page or scroll to the service card.

quotes: Search services - Not filtering services when you type

acceptanceCriteria: Search bar filters services in real-time as user types
Dropdown results appear below the search input showing matching services
Dropdown displays service name, category, and matches query against service description
Clicking a search result navigates to the Services page and highlights or scrolls to that service card
Search dropdown has proper z-index to appear above other elements

requirements.text: Fix mobile dropdown scrolling issues for service category filter buttons and all service dropdowns throughout the application. Apply max-height: 260px, overflow-y: auto, -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch, overscroll-behavior: contain, and z-index: 9999 to enable smooth scrolling within dropdowns. Prevent page body scroll when a dropdown is open on mobile devices. Ensure dropdown remains open while scrolling its contents.

quotes: Service dropdown must scroll smoothly on mobile. Page behind should NOT scroll. Dropdown should stay open while scrolling.

acceptanceCriteria: Service category filter buttons (All, Pest Control, Carpentry, etc.) scroll smoothly on mobile
Service dropdowns on Booking page and Reviews page scroll smoothly without page body scrolling
Dropdowns have max-height: 260px with vertical scroll enabled
Touch-based scrolling is smooth with -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch
Page content behind dropdown does not scroll when dropdown is open on mobile
Dropdown remains open and functional while scrolling its contents
